capability.name: ChunkIO Boolean-field source contract
capability.inventory_rule: one boolean_field_contract obligation per successfully imported source function; every other enumerated source function is a residual Unknown row carrying a reason

scope: Inventory completeness of the source-derived obligation set. This is not a claim about source safety, custody, lifecycle or whole-unit verdicts.

enumeration.audit_backstop: crates/qcore-audit/src/source_audit.rs analyze_unit emits an Unknown row for every raw_functions entry the typed import did not return

provider_coverage_gates.rule: discharged != task.coverage_for(capability) -> Unknown; evidence.coverage != task.coverage_for(capability) -> Unknown
certificate coverage must equal the core-derived required set
a capability with any DerivationIncomplete marker can never reach Safe

residual_boundaries.statement: A function definition that exists only after macro expansion, and a K&R-style definition, are absent from legacy_c_source_functions and therefore absent from the derived inventory entirely - no obligation and no residual Unknown row.
residual_boundaries.consequence: the reported checked/Unknown split is not a complete function denominator for such units; nothing is promoted, and a call into an excluded definition leaves the caller Unknown

residual_boundaries.statement: Header definitions are outside the audited scope by construction: the enumeration reads the main source text only.
residual_boundaries.consequence: intentional scope statement, recorded in each certificate's scope; not a silent drop within the declared scope

residual_boundaries.statement: Local declaration statements are entirely outside the supported grammar, so a nested call in an initializer is refused by the enclosing declaration rather than by call analysis.
residual_boundaries.consequence: fail-closed, but the residual reason names the declaration, not the call

residual_boundaries.statement: The capability's inventory is exactly one obligation per imported function, so the multi-obligation removal case is exercised only through the generic host coverage gate, not through this capability's own inventory.
residual_boundaries.consequence: coverage omission is tested as the empty set plus substitution and addition
